LESSON: VOLLEYBALL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.9: Volleyball

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Volleyball. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does the volley pass make the Volleyball game interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game
2. perform the volleying skill in Volleyball

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: VOLLEYBALL
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Volleyball helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: VOLLEYBALL
Study Volleyball like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Volleyball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform the volleying skill in Volleyball

What this means
In this part you learn to perform the volleying skill in Volleyball. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform the volleying skill in Volleyball.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Volleyball in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform the volleying skill in Volleyball. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Volleyball is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Volleyball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Volleyball in your own words. (skill: perform the volleying skill in Volleyball)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Volleyball to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game.
3. Practise this skill: perform the volleying skill in Volleyball.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Volleyball from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Volleyball: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Volleyball?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the volley pass make the Volleyball game interesting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Volleyball means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game.
5. Be able to: perform the volleying skill in Volleyball.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
